question: Pembrolizumab alone or with chemotherapy versus cetuximab-chemotherapy in first-line recurrent/metastatic HNSCC.
effect: CPS ≥20 median OS 14.9 vs 10.7 months (HR 0.61); CPS ≥1 12.3 vs 10.4 months (HR 0.74). Pembrolizumab-chemotherapy total-population OS 13.0 vs 10.7 months (HR 0.77, 95% CI 0.63–0.93; p=0.0034).

question: Cisplatin versus cetuximab with definitive RT for HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer.
effect: Five-year OS 84.6% cisplatin vs 77.9% cetuximab; HR 1.45 (95% CI 1.03–2.05), p=0.0163; cetuximab failed non-inferiority.
nnt: Approx. 15 at 5 years based on rounded fixed-time OS rates.

question: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab in persistent/recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer.
effect: CPS ≥1 median OS 28.6 vs 16.5 months (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.49–0.74); all-comer median OS 26.4 vs 16.8 months (HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.52–0.77).

question: Olaparib maintenance after platinum response in advanced BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer.
effect: Five-year PFS 48% vs 21% (HR 0.33, 95% CI 0.25–0.43). Seven-year OS 67.0% vs 46.5% (HR 0.55, 95% CI 0.40–0.76), did not meet prespecified significance boundary.
nnt: PFS absolute difference 27 points; NNT about 4 at 5 years based on rounded rates (not calculated from median survival).

question: Olaparib plus bevacizumab maintenance, particularly in HRD-positive disease.
effect: Overall ITT median OS 56.5 vs 51.6 months (HR 0.92, 95% CI 0.76–1.12; p=0.4118). HRD-positive 5-year PFS 46.1% vs 19.2% (HR 0.41, 95% CI 0.32–0.54).
nnt: Approx. 4 at 5 years in HRD-positive subgroup based on rounded rates; subgroup-specific.

question: Dostarlimab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel in advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer.
effect: Second interim OS HR 0.69 (95% CI 0.54–0.89; p=0.002) overall; dMMR/MSI-H OS HR 0.32. Initial 24-month PFS 36.1% vs 18.1% overall.
nnt: Approx. 6 at 24 months based on initial reported PFS rates; do not mix with later OS cutoff.

question: Systematic lymphadenectomy after complete macroscopic resection with clinically normal nodes.
effect: Median OS 65.5 vs 69.2 months (HR 1.06, 95% CI 0.83–1.34; p=0.65); median PFS 25.5 months both arms. Repeat laparotomy 12.4% vs 6.5%; 60-day mortality 3.1% vs 0.9%.

question: Preoperative oxaliplatin-fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy in operable locally advanced colon cancer.
effect: Residual/recurrent disease by 2 years 16.9% vs 21.5% (rate ratio 0.72, 95% CI 0.54–0.98; p=0.037); complete resection 94% vs 89%.

question: First-line pembrolizumab versus chemotherapy in MSI-H/dMMR metastatic colorectal cancer.
effect: Median PFS 16.5 vs 8.2 months (HR 0.60, 95% CI 0.45–0.79); 5-year OS 54.8% vs 44.2% (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.53–0.99); grade 3–5 treatment-related AEs 22% vs 67%.

question: Adjuvant pembrolizumab after resection of high-risk stage III melanoma.
effect: Seven-year RFS 50% vs 36% (HR 0.63, 95% CI 0.53–0.74); DMFS 54% vs 42% (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.54–0.76); this analysis does not establish OS benefit.
nnt: Approx. 7 at 7 years, based on rounded RFS rates.
